CVE-2025-13151.applicationUseAssessment: Python pyasn1 is a different library. App does not directly call this C libtasn1 function; transitive native consumers not exhaustively audited.
CVE-2025-13151.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Malformed ASN.1 passed to affected libtasn1 expansion function.
CVE-2025-13151.uncertainty: Earlier application-use assessment is preserved, not independent acceptance. Current page reviewed; no matching supported Bookworm fixed package established. no-DSA/wont-fix does not mean safe.

CVE-2026-76844.mechanism: Current vendor description: webpack-dev-middleware path traversal. Scanner package: zlib1g. Attribution mismatch unresolved.
CVE-2026-76844.applicationUseAssessment: The preserved older assessment described a zlib gz_write path. That mechanism is not established for the current CVE description; it must not be treated as current reachability evidence.
CVE-2026-76844.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Failed gzip stream write followed by affected subsequent gz* operation; native reachability uncertain.
CVE-2026-76844.uncertainty: Need scanner/vendor correction or independent disposition. Match retained without suppression; no safe/fixed conclusion.
CVE-2026-76844.currentDiscrepancy: Fresh Grype associates this ID with zlib1g, but its own description and current Debian page describe webpack-dev-middleware and NOT-FOR-US. No current Bookworm zlib row exists. This is an unresolved scanner/vendor identity conflict, not a remediated package.

CVE-2026-82560.applicationUseAssessment: No Perl POD rendering in app; Pod/Text.pm not found in inspected standard Perl directories. Package-source matching may overstate installed feature.
CVE-2026-82560.untrustedInputPrerequisites: Attacker POD supplied to affected Perl formatter; no app route found.
CVE-2026-82560.uncertainty: Earlier application-use assessment is preserved, not independent acceptance. Current page reviewed; no matching supported Bookworm fixed package established. no-DSA/wont-fix does not mean safe.
